text:
Ava (AE): quick heads-up — Legacy Health pushed back hard on the renewal. They said the 18% uplift is a non-starter given current usage patterns. Meeting set with their procurement Wed 4pm PT. Need recommended options by EOD tomorrow: concession range, alternative commit structures, and confirmation whether security can sign SOC2 addendum.

Sam (CS): thanks for flagging. We ran usage: 1.2B tokens last 12mo, spike on imaging-gen PoC last q3. They want previous unit price for next 12mo and a 90-day POC for a new rerank flow.

Mina (Solutions): for the POC timeline — we can scope a 90-day isolated env on Dedicated small pool. Suggest 3-tier approach: 1) 90d POC on a trial pool, 2) 6mo ramp commit with tiered unit price, 3) auto-fallback to hosted at listed rates. That helps protect unit economics.

Diego (Deal Desk): can we quantify concession? typical max one-off for existing customers is 10% with a commitment bump. If we do 10% we need a 12mo commit + PO upfront or 6mo prepay. Anything bigger requires RevOps sign-off.

Priya (RevOps): confirm: Devex allowance is limited. We can author a 10% temporary ratecard override for one renewal cycle if Legal and Security approve the addendum. If they want longer term devex we'd reprice.

Jared (Security): SOC2 addendum — we can approve standard SOC2 addendum and add an audit clause, but the customer asked for a custom logging retention change and HSM key escrow language. We need details on specific retention window before agreeing. I can draft redlines if they share the SQ section.

Ava (AE): customer asked specifically for: 1) same unit $ as last year, 2) guaranteed 99.9% inference SLA on POC, 3) SOC2 addendum w/ 24mo log retention. They will sign if price + SLA remains.

Mina (Solutions): 99.9% on POC is tough unless we run dedicated capacity behind it. We can offer canary on Dedicated + SLA for the committed phase only. For POC we can offer best-effort and instrumentation to track SLOs.

Diego (Deal Desk): proposed commercial options to present: Option A — 12mo commit at 8% uplift (requires PO + monthly usage true-up), Option B — 12mo commit + 90d POC + 10% one-time concession, Option C — move to Dedicated baseline with volume tiers (higher commit, lower unit). We need AE preference.

Lila (Legal): I'll pre-clear the standard SOC2 addendum and the audit clause. HSM/escrow language will take longer — probably require a separate SOW or enterprise addendum. If they insist on 24mo retention we need to check compliance impact.

Ava (AE): leaning to Option B to buy time. Customer is politically sensitive; procurement needs a show of flexibility. If we draft the 10% concession + POC timeline + signature by end of month we should keep them.

Priya (RevOps): action items for EOD: Diego to draft concession terms + matrix, Mina to write POC tech spec (resource needs + SLA notes), Jared to prepare SOC2 addendum redlines. Lila to flag any legal blockers. I'll queue the ratecard override approval.

Diego (Deal Desk): putting a skeleton concession term here for review: "10% unit price concession for 12mo renewal conditioned on: (i) signed PO within 30 days; (ii) 90d POC kickoff within 45 days; (iii) usage true-up clause." react :thumbsup: if ok.

ops-bot: Deploy notification — ratecard-override draft created by Diego in /deals/1987654321-drafts (internal only).

Jared (Security): I'll add HSM question to redlines and propose a compromise: KMS integration + customer-managed keys for Dedicated; decline escrow. Will send redline by 2pm tomorrow.

Mina (Solutions): POC spec draft incoming — will include test plan, acceptance criteria (latency p95 < 200ms on dedicated pool), and a data-handling section to satisfy their legal folks.

Ava (AE): thanks team — if we can have the docs minus legal boilerplate by 5pm tomorrow I can run tabletop with the customer before Wed meeting. I'll update thread after the call.

Sam (CS): noted, I'll prep a migration/playback plan in case they want immediate cutover post-POC.

Priya (RevOps): queued for internal review. Diego — ping me when you drop the final term sheet.

Diego (Deal Desk): will do.

Ava (AE): FYI — customer procurement keeps referencing prior year 'legacy discounts' as precedent. We'll need to show comparable usage-based metrics to justify concession. I'll attach their usage export in the call.

Lila (Legal): added — if they ask for auto-extension language we should avoid open-ended auto-renew at concession price. Propose a defined renewal window only.

Ava (AE): perfect. circling back after I talk to them Wed. Thanks all :pray:
